about: Targets for the area plan, read by its checks. Ranges are for the world or a realm, never for one place. See docs/areas/rules.md; evidence in docs/research/world-density.md. 'measured' gives the reference value; 'calibrated' is false where the range is a first guess.

invariants.rule: Every place is reachable on foot from Tolling unless marked closed.
From anywhere a player can stand there is a way back to safety and a bank.
Every tier of every gathering skill exists somewhere; each skill's best tiers are where skills.md puts them.
For every stage, a fight's supplies can be obtained and banked somewhere reachable at that stage.
Every name in world-map.md is placed exactly once; new places carry a p- name until named.

targets.metric: share of land 8x8 patches that are empty or sparse
(shops + quest starts) of Cruor / of the next city
towns and villages per 100,000 land tiles
share of villages, towns and cities with a bank
share of land within 100 route tiles of a bank
median route distance between neighbouring fast-travel points
dungeons and caves per named place
stages the realm has reasons to visit in
targets.unless: the realm is marked a destination

measured.rs3: every region but Tirannwn (late only, a destination)

targets.metric: share of quests early / mid / late
heartland's share of quests and of shops

measured.rs3: Misthalin, Asgarnia, Kandarin: about two thirds

variety.warn: more than this share of one tier's settlements have exactly the same set of services
fewer than these shares of settlements lack a bank / fast travel
a realm uses fewer distinct characters, or one character exceeds this share of its places
gaps between banks or fast-travel points are too even (coefficient of variation below this)
two periphery realms have the same profile of reasons and stages
